specRefs: ADR 0002 (signature bytes never part of the preimage)
rationale: The root is computed over the STATEMENT payload bytes, never the envelope: two envelopes with different/multiple signature blocks over the same payload yield the SAME root (counter-signing and key rotation cannot move the action identity). Signatures here are DELIBERATELY fake — this vector pins root invariance, not signature validity.
